summary: Patrick County, VA tower built in the 1960s, sold to a lumber company and removed in the 1980s; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Removed by a lumber company in the 1980s; the exact year is not known

events.note: Removed field reads 1980s, so the exact year is not known; the description says the tower stood through at least around 1980

evidence.supports: the site is in Patrick County, Virginia
tower stood atop the mountain through at least around 1980
evidence.quote: This tower existed atop Simmons Mountain through at least around 1980.

evidence.supports: the site was sold to a lumber company, which removed the tower
evidence.quote: The site was sold to a lumber company, which removed it.

evidence.supports: the Forest Fire Lookout Association list marks the Simmons Mountain site as Tower Gone at coordinates close to the register's
evidence.quote: Simmons Mountain Patrick 36.59766 -80.43511 Tower Gone FFLOS US 2064, VA 45

notes_for_editor: Only the register and the FFLA list cover this site; two web searches found nothing else about Simmons Mountain or a lumber company removal. The register's Built field reads 1960s with no exact year, so no built event is recorded. Access and current condition are unknown and the story says so. The register's nominator is not named in the story. The removal event has no year because the register's Removed field reads 1980s only; a map view of years standing will not show a removal year for this site.
